info.title: ControlOps API
info.description: API for ControlOps web and mobile clients. In Swagger, select **Authorize** and enter the user's email in the Username field plus their password. Other clients sign in with `POST /auth/login` and send the returned Bearer JWT.

detail.description: Human-readable message or structured error details.

EmailPassword.description: Enter the account email in the Username field and the account password.

BadRequest.description: The request is valid JSON but cannot be processed in its current state.

Unauthorized.description: A valid Bearer access token is required.

PaymentRequired.description: The company subscription is blocked or requires payment.

Forbidden.description: The account or role does not have access to this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested tenant-scoped resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing resource or state.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required external integration is unavailable or not configured.
